source.title: Courtly Wrists — first-person MikiMM 1,000 disenchant results (Wowhead comments)
source.author: MikiMM

quote: Disenchanted 1000x with Disenchanting Delegate / Shard Supplier maxed out
notes: First-person 1,000 Courtly Wrists disenchant operations with maxed Disenchanting Delegate / Shard Supplier. Original report gives material UNIT totals by explicit Rank 1/2, not castsWithDrop, zero counts or stack distributions. Source gives no spell build/patch date, item-link-at-cast item level, crafting quality, profession skill or event export. Wowhead's base/selected tooltip item level is NOT the level at disenchant time. Distinct named author cohort; overlap with cumulative Wowhead Looter item 239671 observations remains unknown, so do not sum both as independent without provenance review. Optional profession bonus reagents are included as reported, not presumed from every cast. No measured output probabilities are derived.
specialization: Disenchanting Delegate / Shard Supplier maxed out
